SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
